prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Full SCENE STATE SHEET for a physical Mars expedition game. Match the supplied realistic painterly cream-and-teal machinery, ochre landscape, restrained cobalt science equipment, mustard rover fittings. Locally made parts are simple cut straight steel and bolted joints, never elaborate molded industrial machinery. Factory precision parts are imported. No people, text, numerals, labels, captions, borders, arrows, diagrams or UI. Each panel repeats EXACTLY the same camera, framing, object positions, light, room/landscape and perspective, changing ONLY the specified state. Every recurring object is the same actual object. Frame the full installation in the upper two thirds; lower third is quiet natural floor or ground for the movable inventory. No loose decorative objects. Whole scenes will be cropped into registered fixed targets; keep independent working regions clearly separated. Square panels, not portrait strips.
Layout: 2 columns by 2 rows of equal SQUARE scenes. Reading order left to right then next row. The travel direction is from the foreground AWAY from the viewer toward the layered ice field in the upper background. A shallow dry wash crosses the route from left to right in the middle distance. A sturdy rock stands beside the FAR lip at right; it can take a padded winch sling. The near approach is empty of vehicles because the actual rover is a movable game item. Use the one rover in reference 1 only for the final state.
STATE 1: Bare shallow wash, no panels, winch or rover. Traversable but soft sloping ground, not a deep cliff or ravine.
STATE 2: Two framed traction panels are laid lengthwise ALONG THE TRAVEL DIRECTION: parallel tracks receding from the foreground toward the background, over the shallow wash, fully supported on ground. Their near ends meet the approach and their far ends reach the firm far bank.
STATE 3: Same correctly oriented tracks. The portable powered winch is attached by a padded sling to the far-bank rock beside the panel ends. A coiled recovery line and hook wait on the far end of the tracks; no line stretched into empty foreground, no rover yet.
STATE 4: The same panels, winch and rock remain. The actual cream/mustard six-wheel rover with its ONE insulated scientific case is now beyond the wash, farther away on the ice-field route. Its wheels face away toward the ice. Winch cable released and stowed. No extra rover in foreground.
